subject: MAP: Compliance checkpoint — SOC 2 / SIG / DPA & retention scope for ComplyBank
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@complybank.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: ComplyBank Security <security@complybank.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP kickoff — compliance intake and retention questions

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security team reviewed the initial materials and asked that we start a short MAP focused on the compliance gates: SOC 2 attestation expectations, SIG/CAIQ responses, DPA redline cadence, and the data retention / archival policy for PII and logs.

High-level asks from my side to set scope for the MAP:
- Can you confirm which SOC 2 controls are covered by the hosted offering vs. dedicated/private deployments?
- Do you have a filled SIG/CAIQ we can start from (so we don't duplicate work)?
- What is the default retention for request logs and generated content? Can that be shortened to 90 days for our account?
- Typical DPA turnaround time for a redline review (we prefer DocuSign).

Target timeline: we need security review notes by Jan 21 to make procurement decisions before month-end.

Attached: none in this message — will share our intake spreadsheet once I confirm attendees.

Thanks,
Alice Jenkins
Head of Security Programs
ComplyBank
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@complybank.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — compliance intake and retention questions

Alice — thanks, really appreciate the clear asks. Happy to run a tight MAP to get you to procurement. Quick answers and proposed next steps: 

- SOC 2: Our hosted API is covered by our SOC 2 Type II (controls map attached). Dedicated/Private can be scoped similarly, but there are carve-outs for customer-managed networking and on-prem storage — I'll have Neha confirm specifics.
- SIG/CAIQ: we maintain a baseline SIG spreadsheet; if you send your template we can pre-fill it.
- Retention: default request logs are 180 days. We can propose a 90-day retention for ComplyBank under a contractual amendment; need product/ops review.
- DPA: typical redline turnaround is 7–10 business days after we receive a redline. We can use DocuSign for signature.

I've created a draft MAP workbook and attached the initial MAP with milestones and owners (Redwood_MAP_Draft_for_ComplyBank.xlsx). Proposed cadence: security intake by 2026-01-14, SIG prefill by 2026-01-15, DPA redline exchange by 2026-01-18, and final sign by 2026-01-28. Does that align with your procurement window?

I'll loop in our security lead (Neha) and legal (Marcus) to confirm retention/archival limits.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

Stephanie — quick outline and proposed artifacts. I can own the SIG prefill and SOC 2 control breakdown. Marcus can handle DPA/legal language.

1) SOC 2 scope (short bullets we can include in MAP workbook):
- Hosted (Redwood API): infrastructure and platform controls covered (CC1–CC6 families); encryption-in-transit & at-rest, key management integrations documented.
- Dedicated/Private: same application controls but customer-managed network / storage carve-outs; we call out these exceptions in the acceptance criteria.

2) Retention options:
- Default: request logs retained 180 days; generated content retention configurable for Private but default hosted is 180 days.
- Proposed 90-day option: feasible as an account-level contractual SLA for hosted if we restrict certain caching features and agree to no backups beyond 90 days. Needs Product Ops sign-off and explicit DPA annex.

3) SIG/CAIQ: I'll fill our baseline SIG into the workbook and mark any answers that vary by deployment mode. Target to return a prefilled SIG to ComplyBank by 2026-01-15.

4) DPA / redline: Marcus — typical turnaround is 7–10 business days. Recommend we prepare a DPA draft (Redwood_DPA_Draft_v2.pdf) and open DocuSign once ComplyBank returns a redline.

I attached the SIG template with our baseline values and a proposed retention clause snippet for the MAP.

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security and Compliance
Redwood Inference
